title: SAP Sales Order
description: SAP S/4HANA sales order payload. Field names follow the OData service API_SALES_ORDER_SRV (entity A_SalesOrder / A_SalesOrderItem).

SalesOrder.description: SAP document number. Omit when the order is being created; SAP assigns it.

SalesOrderType.description: Order type. OR = standard order, RE = returns, CS = cash sale, FD = free of charge delivery.

SalesOrganization.description: Sales organization that owns the order, e.g. 1710.

DistributionChannel.description: Distribution channel, e.g. 10 = direct sales, 20 = resale.

OrganizationDivision.description: Division of the product line, e.g. 00.

SoldToParty.description: Customer number of the ordering party (partner role SP/AG).

ShipToParty.description: Customer number of the goods recipient (partner role SH/WE). Defaults to SoldToParty.

PurchaseOrderByCustomer.description: Customer purchase order / reference number printed on the source document.

CustomerPurchaseOrderDate.description: Date of the customer purchase order, YYYY-MM-DD.

SalesOrderDate.description: Document date of the sales order, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

RequestedDeliveryDate.description: Header-level delivery date requested by the customer, YYYY-MM-DD.

TotalNetAmount.description: Net order value in TransactionCurrency, decimal string with 2 decimals.

CustomerPaymentTerms.description: Payment terms key, e.g. 0001 = immediately, NT30 = net 30 days.

IncotermsClassification.description: Incoterms code, e.g. EXW, FOB, DAP, CIF.

ShippingCondition.description: Shipping condition key, e.g. 01 = standard, 02 = express.

HeaderBillingBlockReason.description: Billing block key. Empty means not blocked.

DeliveryBlockReason.description: Delivery block key. Empty means not blocked.

SalesOrderText.description: Free-text header note carried from the source document.

SalesOrderItemText.description: Short description of the material as stated on the source document.

RequestedQuantity.description: Ordered quantity, decimal string with 3 decimals, greater than zero.

RequestedQuantityUnit.description: Unit of measure, SAP UoM code, e.g. PC, KG, L, M.

NetAmount.description: Net value of the item in TransactionCurrency, 2 decimals.

ItemRequestedDeliveryDate.description: Item-level delivery date when it differs from the header date.

MaterialByCustomer.description: Customer material number, when the source document uses the customer catalog.

to_Partner.description: Additional business partners beyond sold-to and ship-to.

PartnerFunction.description: Partner function: SP sold-to, SH ship-to, BP bill-to, PY payer.

Customer.description: Customer number holding that partner function.
